record: 27 September 2026 build record 18 — reachable components, not acceptance
checkpoint: Plan-first inspection remains the sequencing rule: 193 Before Build requirements and 501 exact clauses, no further browser submission. Current controlled composition regression: 193 passing cases in .nm/evaluations/composed-plan-components-20260927.xml; earlier overlapping suites are not added to this population. Source inspection distinguishes component wiring, mandatory curated legal populations, qualified approval and semantic/browser acceptance. Original USD5 ledger remains USD0.224073; grant expired, no new paid call, reset or client cutover. BK-85-AC3 stays NOT_RUN.

rows.progress: Encrypted account-owned working preferences are now reachable through authenticated view/edit/delete routes, the normal profile UI and the controlled context factory. Only approved short/standard/detailed, prose/bullets, authority-position, date-format, supported court IDs and standing switches are typed. Each new turn acquires the current account setting; an old turn retains its exact original prefix and history. Settings cannot become client facts, legal support, instructions to ignore guards or another account's preference.
rows.gaps: Approved typed vocabulary only: free-form standing instructions and unsupported court IDs are not implemented. Delete removes active settings, not sealed prior prefixes or backups. Actual browser profile presentation and professional/model-quality acceptance remain pending.

rows.progress: An owner-file playbook catalogue and on-demand reader are installed in actual tool discovery and the principles prefix. Five guides provide bounded practice navigation, not current legal rules or deterministic matter routing. Optional exact Act/section or reporter pointers are read back through existing evidence/search owners. Changed guide content changes the guide/context identity. Model prose cannot edit the catalogue or certify a pointer.
rows.gaps: Five navigation guides are not a full curated practice library or counsel approval. Several guides have no curated source pointers. Exact pointer resolution does not establish relevance, applicability, completeness or current law.

rows.progress: Date-qualified provision candidates now have exact wording/amendment/commencement/ending/transition span ownership and half-open effective intervals, with explicit source-version identities, digests and attributable expiring review receipts. The actual controlled read_provision tool uses the adapter's dated reader. Missing interval proof leaves held words accessible as unassessed source windows rather than inventing a supporting Finding from an Act-level lifetime. Repealed-code refusals do not silently substitute successors.
rows.gaps: Production has no populated, authenticated provision-revision registry yet. Its loader, qualified-artifact lookup and composition are separate current engineering work; historical source acquisition/curation and qualified legal approval are not supplied by synthetic fixtures. A source-reader text view is not interval approval.

rows.progress: Actual tool discovery now offers source-bound limitation selection proposals and reviewed event-based calculation. Selection uses exact owned observations, primary clauses and independently sealed judgments; the composed resolver recomputes current subjects and saved review receipts. Arithmetic preserves inferred/unknown legal premises, competing event dates and clock-moving factors. It never confirms an allegation, replaces Fact.date or registers its conditional date as a filing deadline.
rows.gaps: Fresh proposal review currently completes after the author terminal; an automatic same-request post-review calculation continuation is not claimed. Interest arithmetic and legal fee schedules remain separate missing components/data. Live accrual-selection accuracy and professional acceptance are unmeasured.

rows.progress: A private working-record owner now reconstructs the entire original request, scoped needs, current facts, held legal windows, owned documents and actual executed work. Candidate annotations record analysis area, considered/kept/set-aside disposition, exact support and dependencies without author-written PASS. Source support and request scope are independently saved and reconstructed. Completion cannot be derived from an empty list or the author's chosen narrow subset.
rows.gaps: Scope and coverage sufficiency remain semantic judgments, not mathematical guarantees. Exact support alone does not satisfy duty/consistency and all channel-release checks for annotation prose; private explanations are not displayed as advice. Input-only notes without legal support do not manufacture a legal Finding. Live comprehensive-brief acceptance is pending.

rows.progress: Whole-request independent scope checks examine every owned area and need by dispute, require exact original-request words, and name only already independently checked annotations as coverage. Seven applicable working-analysis areas are required for a comprehensive requested brief, with unknown or inapplicable reasons retained. Narrow questions and acknowledgements are not forced into seven headings. Actual composition shares the same transactional journal with source and wording reviews.

rows.progress: Casefile original-document opening now uses only the actual opaque owned upload identity carried by source attribution. The original-view route rechecks session, scope, matter/asset versions, exact bytes/digest, local reading permission, quarantine and retention before transport, bounded at 8MiB. Text uses textContent; PDF uses an isolated sandboxed no-referrer blob frame; DOCX is a guarded download rather than pretend inline HTML. Blob resources are revoked on close or context change.

rows.progress: Four conversational private-file tools are installed in actual discovery and the authenticated preview composition: read owned inputs, propose an inferred legal premise, propose a product decision, and withdraw an exact private inferred premise into a provenance-preserving unestablished tombstone. Exact reserved arguments, current sources, observations, original instruction, actor/scope and before/after projections are replayed at transactional commit. The model cannot overwrite a human choice, settle law, grant consent, confirm a fact or authorize an external act. Late source revocation now produces a saved refusal instead of an operational crash, without applying the mutation or expanding admitted scope.
